MOKLANJO · KA SYSTEM JONG KA KAM COURIER
Thoh, phah bad pynbeit ia man ka parsel — kawei ka OS courier ha ki device jong phi.

Ki khata, ki kot, COD, ki label, ki pool AWB, ka jingbud, ki nongniah kali bad ka bill — baroh ka lynti naduh ka kaunta haduh ka jingpynbeit, lada don lane ym don internet. Khlem siew dor ha ki device jong phi.
Ka jingkhia shisha bad ka jingkhia da ka jingheh, iakhap ia ki.
Ka kot dor jong phi, ka pisa lane ka khata.
Kawei ka jingnion ka pynthylli ia ka kaunta na ka bynta u nongwan ba bud.
Scroll — ka lynti jingiaid parsel haneng ka pyni hangno phi don ha ka khana.
Ka jingkhia shisha lane ka jingkhia da ka jingheh — kaba kham jrong, la pynbeit kumba phi kwah.
KA JINGKHIA BA DONKAM BAN SIEW
Ka jingheh jong ka box ka buh ia ka dor.
Kaba kham jrong na kiba ar, la pynkiew sha ka 0.5 kg ba bud.

Ha ka app ka dukan ka buh ia u nongbynta, ka jingpynbeit bad ki unit jong phi (cm lane inch, kg lane lb). U chip Bar ri u kylla ia ka ÷6000 na ka bynta kawei ka parsel khlem da kylla ia Ki jingpynbeit.
Ki kot dor jong phi, ki dor khata jong phi — bad ka jingmyntoi jong phi ha man u docket.
Ha ka jaka · Ha ka khyndew
Ka jaka × ka jingshakri × ka slab jingkhia
Ka slab nyngkong bad man ka slab ba la pyndap, na man ka jaka bad ka jingshakri.
Ka kot dor jong u nongphah mar hi
Ki nongphah ba ju wan ki ioh ia ki dor jong ki; ka kot ba la buh ka kynthup ia kiwei baroh.
Ka dor die jong phi pyrshah bad ka dor jong u nongkit, ha man u docket.
AWB na ki pool nombar jong phi hi. Label, scan, wad.
Ki pool nombar na man u nongkit
Thoh shisien ia ka series sdang–kut jong man u nongkit; man ka parsel ka shim ia u nombar ba bud.
U AWB u leit ha ka box kum ka barcode bad kum ki nombar ba paw.
Scan ia ka label ban plie ia u docket jong ka bad trei ia ka.
Ai ia ka sha u nongkit, lane phah ia u nongniah kali jong phi hi. Kajuh ka system.
Hapoh ka pla jong u nongkit
Ka manifest ka bat tang ia ki parsel ba phi la jied — baroh lane ym don. Ka parsel ba la thoh na ka bynta uwei pat u nongkit kam lah ban rung ha kane ka pla.
Ha ka jingleit jong u nongniah kali jong phi
Jied ia ki parsel, pynmih ia ka kot jingleit, bad u nongniah kali u trei na kajuh ka app ha ka mode nongniah kali — lang bad ka jingpynshisha jingpynpoi.
Man ka jingiaid la thoh — bad tang ki jingiaid kiba don jingmut.
La thoh → Ha u nongkit → La mih ban pynpoi → La pynpoi
→ ka daw → mih biang, lane pynphai biang sha u nongphah.
Ki jingiaid kiba bym lah la len
La pynpoi, la pynphai bad la pynsangeh ki dei kiba kut.
Kawei ka dur bad ka sain jong u nongioh ha u docket.
Ki daw, ki jingpyrshang, mih biang, lane phai sha u nongphah.
7 · KA PISA KA WAN SHA IING
Ka COD ba phi lah ban iohi: kaba dei ban don, kaba la ai, kaba dei ban siew sha man u nongphah mar.
Ka pisa jong u nongniah kali, ha ka jingkut ka jingleit
Duna ₹ 200 ha u nongniah kali B — la kyrteng, kam jah ha ka baroh.
Kaba la lum pyrshah bad kaba la siew, na man u nongphah mar, bad ki batch jingphah pisa.
Ka jingpynbeit pisa jong u nongniah kali
Kaba dei ban don pyrshah bad kaba la ai, bad ka slip commission.
Ka kot sngi, ka bill man u bnai na man ka account, bad ka CSV jingkhein GST na ka bynta u nongkhein jong phi.
Bteng ban thoh ia ki parsel.
Ka jingthoh parsel, ki label, ka jingscan, ka COD bad ki kot baroh ki trei ha ki device jong phi. Haba ka internet ka duh, ym don ei ei ha ka kaunta ba ap ia ka.
Router jong ka ophis: ym don internet
Ka miej: dang thoh ia ki parsel
Ka kaunta ba ar bad ka phone jong u nongniah kali: la iasoh ha ka Wi-Fi jong ka ophis
Khlem siew dor junom ha ki device jong phi
Ym don ei ei na man u nongniah kali, u nongpyndonkam lane ka parsel. Kumkaj Cloud lada phi kwah: Steady ₹6k · Swift ₹12k · Priority ₹24k/snem khlem ka shuiñ — /shop.
Kawei ka OS courier. Ki parsel jong phi. Ki kot jong phi.
Moklanjo ka dei kawei ka system jong ka kam courier baroh hapoh Kumkaj — Android, Windows bad Linux. Ki nongniah kali ki pyndonkam ia kajuh ka app ha ka mode nongniah kali.
